'''Arari''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Blaudu Sextus]]. In [[44 ABY]], a [[Blaudu Sextus revolt|revolt]] of the [[Octusi]]&mdash;[[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|natives]] of nearby [[Blaudu Octus]]&mdash;against their masters was provoked by the anti-[[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] organization [[Freedom Flight]]. The Octusi staged peaceful marches in Arari, but [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] feared that allowing the revolt to go unchecked would spark rebellion on more worlds, and thus sent a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] force under the command of [[Belok Rhal]] to put down the revolt. Rhal corralled several Octusi in the [[Big Circle of Fun]] in Arari and massacred them when they refused to stop their revolt. His actions were reported live by [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Madhi Vaandt]], whom he proceeded to kill, before the Mandalorians were finally found and stopped by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Sothais Saar]] and [[Avinoam Arelis]].
